info.title: roslyn-query
info.description: A global dotnet CLI tool for semantic C# codebase queries via the Roslyn API. Designed for LLM coding agents — structured tab-delimited output minimizes token usage and enables faster codebase exploration.

commands.name: batch
commands.description:
Read commands from stdin, one per line (uses daemon)
daemon stop [solution.sln|.slnx] Stop the background daemon for a solution

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Summary card: kind, location, base, interfaces, member counts

commands.name: find-attribute
commands.description: All symbols decorated with an attribute

commands.name: find-callers
commands.description: All invocation call sites of a method

commands.name: find-impl
commands.description: All implementations/subclasses of an interface or class

commands.name: find-overrides
commands.description: All overrides of a virtual/abstract member

commands.name: find-refs
commands.description: All references to a type, property, or method

commands.name: list-members
commands.description: All members of a type (properties, methods, fields)

commands.name: list-projects
commands.description: All projects in the solution (name + path)

commands.name: list-types
commands.description: All types in a namespace (prefix match)

options.name: --context
options.description: Show trimmed source line alongside file:line output

options.name: --all
options.description: Return results for all matching symbols when ambiguous

options.name: --inherited
options.description: Include inherited members in list-members output

options.name: --absolute
options.description: Show absolute file paths (default: relative to solution)

options.name: --limit
options.description: Cap output to N lines (remainder count on stderr)

options.name: --count
options.description: Print only the result count (not supported on find-base or list-members)

options.name: --in-project
options.description:
Scope results to a single project (case-insensitive name match)
Internal:

options.name: --daemon
options.description:
If solution path is omitted, searches parent directories for a .sln or .slnx file.
Symbol format: TypeName  or  TypeName.MemberName
Repeated queries automatically use a background daemon for fast responses
(under 1 second after the first query).
